requirements.text: The bidder must complete Form SRAA - 5007.

requirements.quote: Specify in detail the particular work items to be performed thereof and associated dollar amounts
requirements.text: The bidder must specify work items and associated dollar amounts.
The MWBE contractor must provide their signature.

requirements.quote: I certify that on (Date) I contacted the following New York State Certified Minority/Women Business Enterprises by registered mail to obtain bids for work to be performed on the above-mentioned contract.
requirements.text: The bidder must certify contacting NYS Certified MWBEs by registered mail for bids.

requirements.quote: List the names of M/WBEs and type of work that bids were requested
requirements.text: The bidder must list names of MWBEs and work types for bid requests.

requirements.quote: To the best of my knowledge and belief, said New York State Certified Minority/Women Business Enterprise contractor(s) was unavailable for work on this project, or unable to prepare a bid for the following reasons:
requirements.text: The bidder must provide reasons for MWBE unavailability or inability to bid.
The prime consultant/contractor must provide their signature.
